children.text:

If you are a citizen of Georgia or hold residency in an EU member state, you will need a visa to travel to the UK.
To apply, the following steps must be completed:
The visa decision is made by the UK consulate in Istanbul. Processing time may vary depending on the season and the volume of applications received, but it usually takes around 3 weeks.

The UK Standard Visitor visa is valid for a minimum of 6 months and allows multiple entries.
Other visitor visas are also available – valid for 2, 5, or 10 years.
However, it's important to note that with these visas, the length of stay in the country must not exceed 180 days per entry.

page.title: Duration of the UK visitor visa

children.text: A valid passport (valid for at least 6 more months)
Copies of old passports
An employment letter stating your salary (in English)
A bank statement confirming your financial standing
A motivation letter
Hotel and flight reservations
Marriage and children's birth certificates (if applicable)

Under updated rules, the UK is discontinuing sticker visas. They will be replaced by an electronic visa. However, it's important to remember: a visit to the visa center to submit biometric data remains mandatory.
Travelers who already hold a valid sticker visa will need to convert it to the electronic format – activation.
Be sure to include all required documentation and information in your application. Make sure your passport is valid for at least six months from your planned return date.
Provide evidence of your financial means, so the consular officer can see that you have a stable income in your home country that you intend to use during your stay in the UK.
Be honest and accurate in your application and avoid providing false information.
Be prepared to answer additional questions if UK border officers ask.
Submit your visa application 3 months before your trip.
There is no separate "England visa" - you receive a UK visa, which allows you to travel to England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland.

There are several reasons for a UK visa refusal, though the main factors that most often determine the decision relate to how well the applicant can demonstrate their intent to return to their home country and how well they meet all required financial and documentary requirements.
Insufficient ties to home country:

one of the most common reasons for a visa refusal is when the applicant cannot demonstrate sufficient ties to their home country, suggesting they might not return home and could remain in the UK unlawfully.
Insufficient financial resources:
the consul must be convinced that the applicant has enough financial means to cover all expenses of travel and their stay in the UK.
Incorrect or insufficient documents:
incomplete or incorrectly filled-out documents can lead to a visa refusal. It's important that all requested documents are submitted complete and correct.
Limited travel history:
if the applicant lacks sufficient prior travel history demonstrating responsibility and proof of return, the visa may be refused.

content.text: What determines whether I'll get a visa?

children.text: It's difficult to predict the likelihood of a specific applicant being granted a visa. However, it's clear that this depends on your social and economic ties in your home country. The more you can show the consul that you are successful in your home country, have a stable income, and future growth potential, the more likely you are to be granted a visa.
The UK visa is issued by the UK Consular Service in Istanbul, Turkey. Visa documents are submitted at the "UK Visa Application Centre" office, located at:
92 Tsagareli St., 1st floor, Tbilisi.

content.text: Does the eConsul guarantee the visa?

children.text: No one else can interfere with the consul's decision on issuing a visa; this decision is final. However, our qualified professionals will do everything possible to prepare your documents properly and in your favor for the consulate, so the consul fully understands your current circumstances and prospects, which increases the likelihood of the visa being granted.

content.text: How long does it take for the visa to be issued?

children.text: In most cases, documents are reviewed within 2 weeks of payment and document submission. However, the review period may be extended or shortened depending on specific circumstances.
